entries.title: Luke 23:1
segments: ¶And the whole multitude of them, rising up, led him to Pilate.

entries.title: Luke 23:2
segments: And they began to accuse him, saying, We have found this [man] perverting our nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

entries.title: Luke 23:3
segments: And Pilate demanded of him saying, Art *thou* the king of the Jews? And he answering him said, Thou sayest.

entries.title: Luke 23:4
segments: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, I find no guilt in this man.

entries.title: Luke 23:5
segments: But they insisted, saying, He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judaea, beginning from Galilee even on to here.

entries.title: Luke 23:6
segments: But Pilate, having heard Galilee [named], demanded if the man were a Galilaean;

entries.title: Luke 23:7
segments: and having learned that he was of Herod's jurisdiction, remitted him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem in those days.

entries.title: Luke 23:8
segments: And when Herod saw Jesus he greatly rejoiced, for he had been a long while desirous of seeing him, because of hearing many things concerning him, and he hoped to see some sign done by him;

entries.title: Luke 23:9
segments: and he questioned him in many words, but *he* answered him nothing.

entries.title: Luke 23:10
segments: And the chief priests and the scribes stood and accused him violently.

entries.title: Luke 23:11
segments: And Herod with his troops having set him at nought and mocked him, having put a splendid robe upon him, sent him back to Pilate.

entries.title: Luke 23:12
segments: And Pilate and Herod became friends with one another the same day, for they had been at enmity before between themselves.

entries.title: Luke 23:13
segments: ¶And Pilate, having called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

entries.title: Luke 23:14
segments: said to them, Ye have brought to me this man as turning away the people [to rebellion], and behold, I, having examined him before you, have found nothing criminal in this man as to the things of which ye accuse him;

entries.title: Luke 23:15
segments: nor Herod either, for I remitted you to him, and behold, nothing worthy of death is done by him.

entries.title: Luke 23:16
segments: Having chastised him therefore, I will release him.

entries.title: Luke 23:17
segments: (Now he was obliged to release one for them at the feast.)

entries.title: Luke 23:18
segments: But they cried out in a mass saying, Away with this [man] and release Barabbas to us;

entries.title: Luke 23:19
segments: who was one who, for a certain tumult which had taken place in the city, and [for] murder, had been cast into prison.

entries.title: Luke 23:20
segments: Pilate therefore, desirous to release Jesus, again addressed [them].

entries.title: Luke 23:21
segments: But they cried out in reply saying, Crucify, crucify him.

entries.title: Luke 23:22
segments: And he said the third time to them, What evil then has this [man] done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will chastise him therefore and release him.

entries.title: Luke 23:23
segments: But they were urgent with loud voices, begging that he might be crucified. And their voices [and those of the chief priests] prevailed.

entries.title: Luke 23:24
segments: And Pilate adjudged that what they begged should take place.

entries.title: Luke 23:25
segments: And he released him who, for tumult and murder, had been cast into prison, whom they begged for, and Jesus he delivered up to their will.

entries.title: Luke 23:26
segments: ¶And as they led him away, they laid hold on a certain Simon, a Cyrenian, coming from the field, and put the cross upon him to bear it behind Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 23:27
segments: And a great multitude of the people, and of women who wailed and lamented him, followed him.

entries.title: Luke 23:28
segments: And Jesus turning round to them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep over me, but weep over yourselves and over your children;

entries.title: Luke 23:29
segments: for behold, days are coming in which they will say, Blessed [are] the barren, and wombs that have not borne, and breasts that have not given suck.

entries.title: Luke 23:30
segments: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall upon us; and to the hills, Cover us:

entries.title: Luke 23:31
segments: for if these things are done in the green tree, what shall take place in the dry?

entries.title: Luke 23:32
segments: ¶Now two others also, malefactors, were led with him to be put to death.

entries.title: Luke 23:33
segments: And when they came to the place which is called Skull, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, the other on the left.

entries.title: Luke 23:34
segments: And Jesus said, Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do. And, parting out his garments, they cast lots.

entries.title: Luke 23:35
segments: And the people stood beholding, and the rulers also [with them] sneered, saying, He has saved others; let him save himself if this is the Christ, the chosen one of God.

entries.title: Luke 23:36
segments: And the soldiers also made game of him, coming up offering him vinegar,

entries.title: Luke 23:37
segments: and saying, If *thou* be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

entries.title: Luke 23:38
segments: And there was also an inscription [written] over him in Greek, and Roman, and Hebrew letters: This is the King of the Jews.

entries.title: Luke 23:39
segments: Now one of the malefactors who had been hanged spoke insultingly to him, saying, Art not thou the Christ? save thyself and us.

entries.title: Luke 23:40
segments: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost *thou* too not fear God, thou that art under the same judgment?

entries.title: Luke 23:41
segments: and *we* indeed justly, for we receive the just recompense of what we have done; but this [man] has done nothing amiss.

entries.title: Luke 23:42
segments: And he said to Jesus, Remember me, [Lord,] when thou comest in thy kingdom.

entries.title: Luke 23:43
segments: And Jesus said to him, Verily I say to thee, To-day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

entries.title: Luke 23:44
segments: ¶And it was about [the] sixth hour, and there came darkness over the whole land until [the] ninth hour.

entries.title: Luke 23:45
segments: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple rent in the midst.

entries.title: Luke 23:46
segments: And Jesus, having cried with a loud voice, said, Father, into thy hands I commit my spirit. And having said this, he expired.

entries.title: Luke 23:47
segments: Now the centurion, seeing what took place, glorified God, saying, In very deed this man was just.

entries.title: Luke 23:48
segments: And all the crowds who had come together to that sight, having seen the things that took place, returned, beating [their] breasts.

entries.title: Luke 23:49
segments: And all those who knew him stood afar off, the women also who had followed him from Galilee, beholding these things.

entries.title: Luke 23:50
segments: ¶And behold, a man named Joseph, who was a councillor, a good man and a just

entries.title: Luke 23:51
segments: (this [man] had not assented to their counsel and deed), of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who also waited, [himself also,] for the kingdom of God

entries.title: Luke 23:52
segments: --he having gone to Pilate begged the body of Jesus;

entries.title: Luke 23:53
segments: and having taken it down, wrapped it in fine linen and placed him in a tomb hewn in the rock, where no one had ever been laid.

entries.title: Luke 23:54
segments: And it was preparation day, and [the] sabbath twilight was coming on.

entries.title: Luke 23:55
segments: And women, who had come along with him out of Galilee, having followed, saw the sepulchre and how his body was placed.

entries.title: Luke 23:56
segments: And having returned they prepared aromatic spices and ointments, and remained quiet on the sabbath, according to the commandment.
